column1: # Self-written for this repository (MIT, like the rest of the Android project).
# No private data and no copied text: everyday chat chunks of 2-8 characters.
# Columns: group <TAB> split <TAB> hanzi <TAB> pinyin <TAB> tags
#   group   a conversation theme; the dev/test split is by group, never by phrase
#   split   dev (used for tuning) or test (held out: never used to tune anything)
#   pinyin  one toneless syllable per character, separated by spaces, ü written v
#   tags    comma-separated: weak (a 0.8.8 weak spot), clash (keys shared by
#           two common syllables), name, colloq, poly (polyphone in the phrase)
# Digit and letter inputs are derived from the pinyin by the harness
# (PinyinBenchmark.java); there are no hand-written digit strings to drift.
